BiblicalUsage: A present is a gift brought as homage. Kings shall bring presents unto God because of His temple at Jerusalem, all that are round about Him shall bring presents unto Him that ought to be feared, and Isaiah sees the present brought unto the LORD of hosts from a people scattered and peeled. The gift travels a long way to reach the right throne.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe presents preach what words cannot: the giver knows who is King. Kings bring gifts to Jerusalem, and I hold that my own gifts belong at the same throne.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
